global_layoffs.description: Uber announced plans to cut approximately 3,300 global jobs, or about 10% of its workforce, as part of a restructuring and efficiency program in a period of increased AI investment.
Intuit announced approximately 3,000 job cuts, representing about 17% of its workforce, while stating that it would streamline operations and focus on strategic areas including AI.
Oracle reportedly eliminated 546 positions in its America Cloud Infrastructure business amid continued cloud and AI infrastructure investment.
Meta reportedly began cutting approximately 10% of its workforce, or around 8,000 employees, during a broader technology-sector restructuring cycle linked to efficiency and AI investment.

ai_workforce_signals.headline: AI adoption favors senior roles while junior employment declines
ai_workforce_signals.description: A study covering companies in 41 countries found that organizations adopting AI increased senior employment by 6.7% over five years while junior employment declined by 3%. The findings indicate that AI adoption may reshape workforce composition even when total employment rises.

ai_workforce_signals.headline: AI productivity gains are appearing through weaker wage growth
ai_workforce_signals.description: Research covering 321 occupations found slower wage growth in occupations more exposed to AI, while overall employment levels remained broadly unchanged. The researchers concluded that employers may be capturing productivity gains through reduced wage growth rather than immediate headcount reductions.

ai_workforce_signals.headline: Enterprise AI is driving workforce redesign
ai_workforce_signals.description: TalentNeuron reported that organizations are moving from AI experimentation toward large-scale adoption and redesigning workforces around changing talent requirements. The development points to task and role reconfiguration as a major near-term labor-market effect.

ai_workforce_signals.headline: ServiceNow forecasts technology-sector job growth alongside AI adoption
ai_workforce_signals.description: ServiceNow projected 432,000 additional UK technology, media and telecommunications jobs by 2031, a 28.2% increase from current levels. Its survey also found that 65% of respondents expected organizational headcount to increase over the following three years.

ai_workforce_signals.headline: Workers are acquiring AI skills faster than employers provide training
ai_workforce_signals.description: iCIMS reported that workers are increasingly teaching themselves AI-related skills while employers struggle to keep pace with training demand. The most concentrated AI skill requirements include generative AI engineering, machine learning engineering, artificial intelligence engineering and data science.

ai_workforce_signals.headline: AI adoption is shifting hiring toward data-center roles
ai_workforce_signals.description: Recent workforce reporting indicated that demand for data-center jobs is rising alongside increased AI investment. This suggests that AI-related infrastructure is creating specialized employment even as automation pressures other occupational categories.

weekly_stats.notable_trend: AI adoption is increasingly reshaping workforce composition through fewer junior opportunities, slower wage growth and role redesign, while major announced cuts remain primarily broader restructuring events with AI cited as a contributing strategic factor rather than the sole cause.
